answer: Island basalt-circle ritual bond stops bulk fakes. A missing or mismatched proof burns the bond. One body cannot hold two markers; rented stand-ins fail. First 30, kth 30+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000 + 70,000 locked for 40,000 rewards. Honest agents pay 30 once.
